headline: Poliomyelitis in Idaho after use of live virus vaccine
blurb: In April 1955, two lots of polio vaccine used in Idaho's school program were later shown to contain live virus, and the program was stopped after polio appeared in vaccinated children.

headline: 39-4801. Immunization — exemptions.
blurb: This Idaho law, first passed in 1978, asks for an immunization record when a child enters school and exempts children whose parents sign a statement objecting on religious or other grounds or who have a doctor's certificate.

headline: Interstate Transmission of Measles in a Gypsy Population -- Washington, Idaho, Montana, California
source: CDC, Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report
blurb: Forty-four measles cases with rash onset from September 4 through November 14, 1983, were reported from Washington, Idaho, Montana and California.

headline: "Immunization mobile" brings protection to children in southeastern Idaho.
blurb: With the immunity level among 2-year-olds in southeastern Idaho at 58%, a health district used a specially equipped motor home to bring immunizations to children and their parents.

headline: Alarming increase of Idaho whooping cough cases prompts public health officials to urge pregnant women, parents of small children to get vaccinated
source: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare (archived by the Internet Archive)
blurb: Idaho health officials reported a large increase in whooping cough cases in 2014 compared with 2012 and 2013 and urged pregnant women and people around young children to get vaccinated.

headline: Measles is back in Idaho
source: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare
blurb: Idaho's health department said southwest Idaho had a measles outbreak with 10 reported cases, after only two cases in the state in the prior 20 years.

headline: IDAHO MEDICAL FREEDOM ACT – Amends existing law to establish the Idaho Medical Freedom Act.
blurb: Idaho's governor signed Senate Bill 1210, the Idaho Medical Freedom Act, on April 4, 2025, and it took effect on July 1, 2025.

headline: Measles circulating among Idaho communities--Health officials urge consultation with healthcare provider if ill
source: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare
blurb: Idaho health officials announced a third confirmed measles case in a state resident, an unvaccinated child in Bonner County with no known link to a Kootenai County case announced the week before.
